title: Liability of trustee where beneficiary’s interest is forfeited to the Government
text:
29. Liability of trustee where beneficiary’s interest is forfeited to the Government.—When the

beneficiary’s interest is forfeited or awarded by legal adjudication [to the Government], the trustee is
bound to hold the trust-property to the extent of such interest for the benefit of such person in such
manner as [the State Government] may direct in this behalf.
